thumbnail_ab_note: ⭐ This is Monday's only test — the title is frozen, so the thumbnail carries it. Image + title held constant, TEXT is the sole variable. Read watch-share + per-arm CTR at d7.
thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms (TEXT is the variable): a person standing at an open window in early morning light, eyes closed, shoulders dropped, a cup of tea untouched on the sill. Surbahar resting at the FRAME EDGE, NOT being played. Warm gold dawn against a cool interior. Pichwai/Kangra miniature border, aged parchment, house palette. Text in its own banner panel at ~35% of frame, second tier reading 'Surbahar · Raga Bhairav'. VIEWER LIVING THE MOMENT, never a performer — measured 6.11% vs 3.03%.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — unhurried Indian classical surbahar in Raga Bhairav, deep resonant plucked bass-sitar tone with very long sustain, continuous tanpura drone underneath, no tabla, 60 BPM, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: MORNING lane. 'unhurried' NOT 'slow' — 'slow' makes Suno drag and is reserved for sleep/deep-rest. No tabla (the tabla rule is Sitar-only). 60 BPM, comfortably above the ~55 retention floor from h_2026-09-05_3hr_tempo_retention_floor. Binaural: alpha 10 Hz at -20dB.

production_spec.loop_note: 6-7 unhurried Bhairav surbahar clips over a continuous tanpura bed, long crossfades to ~90 min, consistent bright morning level. No percussion.
